ProFTPD official site compromise distributes backdoored source

Target: proftpd
Repository: https://github.com/proftpd/proftpd
Date: 2010-11-28 to 2010-12-01 (3 days)
Attribution: Individual Hacker
Component: Application
Language: C
Cause: Compromised Infrastructure
Motive: Unauthorized Access/Control
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote code execution
User Impact:
Domain: ftp.proftpd.org (project download host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The main FTP server distributing the ProFTPD source code (`ftp.proftpd.org`) was compromised. Attackers replaced the legitimate source code tarball for ProFTPD version 1.3.3c with a modified version containing a backdoor. Compiling and running this version would allow attackers remote root access.

Compromised Versions

  • 1.3.3c
